name: TF3-OSM-Importer-Mod
summary: Choose a converted Lua map in the game, with saved progress and category controls.
description: Preview OSM importer revision 10. Select a converted .lua map from TF3 userdata in the native file dialog before starting. Map data transfers in small acknowledged chunks and reloads from its selected file. Started imports retain their original map. Compact UI metadata and aggregate category counts reduce repeated work. Object matching, optional towns, network heights and experimental small-water treatment are retained. See README.txt for scope and limits.
